create publication "R" with (publish = 'insert, delete', publish_via_partition_root=true)
CREATE PUBLICATION "R" WITH (publish = 'insert, delete', publish_via_partition_root = true)
create publication p for all sequences, all tables except (table only s.t, t2, table "X") with (publish = 'insert')
CREATE PUBLICATION p FOR ALL TABLES EXCEPT (TABLE ONLY s.t, TABLE t2, TABLE "X"), ALL SEQUENCES WITH (publish = 'insert')
create publication p for all sequences
CREATE PUBLICATION p FOR ALL SEQUENCES
create publication p for table only s.t(x, "Y") where (x > 1), t2, tables in schema current_schema, foo
CREATE PUBLICATION p FOR TABLE ONLY s.t(x, "Y") WHERE (x > 1), TABLE t2, TABLES IN SCHEMA CURRENT_SCHEMA, TABLES IN SCHEMA foo
alter publication p set all sequences, all tables
ALTER PUBLICATION p SET ALL TABLES, ALL SEQUENCES
alter publication p set all tables except (table x, y)
ALTER PUBLICATION p SET ALL TABLES EXCEPT (TABLE x, TABLE y)
alter publication p add table x, y
ALTER PUBLICATION p ADD TABLE x, TABLE y
alter publication p drop tables in schema s1, current_schema
ALTER PUBLICATION p DROP TABLES IN SCHEMA s1, TABLES IN SCHEMA CURRENT_SCHEMA
alter publication p set (publish = 'update')
ALTER PUBLICATION p SET (publish = 'update')
create subscription "S" server "Srv" publication p, "P 2" with (connect = false)
CREATE SUBSCRIPTION "S" SERVER "Srv" PUBLICATION p, "P 2" WITH (connect = false)
create subscription s connection '' publication p with (slot_name = none)
CREATE SUBSCRIPTION s CONNECTION '' PUBLICATION p WITH (slot_name = NONE)
alter subscription s server srv
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s SERVER srv
alter subscription s connection 'host=foo'
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s CONNECTION 'host=foo'
alter subscription s enable
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s  ENABLE
alter subscription s disable
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s  DISABLE
alter subscription s set publication p1, p2 with (refresh=false)
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s SET PUBLICATION p1, p2 WITH (refresh = false)
alter subscription s add publication p2
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s ADD PUBLICATION p2
alter subscription s drop publication p2 with (refresh=false)
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s DROP PUBLICATION p2 WITH (refresh = false)
alter subscription s refresh publication with (copy_data=false)
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s REFRESH PUBLICATION WITH (copy_data = false)
alter subscription s refresh sequences
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s REFRESH SEQUENCES
alter subscription s skip (lsn='0/123')
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s SKIP (lsn = '0/123')
alter subscription s set (slot_name='slot')
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION s SET (slot_name = 'slot')
drop subscription if exists "S" cascade
DROP SUBSCRIPTION IF EXISTS "S" CASCADE
